claim_en: THE EIGHTH OF THE COUNT. Eighth to the consecration (the Sinai third-day analogy), landing on 1 Nisan; the Presence rested on Aaron's service; va-yehi = creation-day joy.
THE CALF ANSWERS THE CALF. The species-to-offense atonement map (ox for the ox-deed, calf for the calf-deed); the fear-slaughtered consolation; alacrity and standing joy.
APPROACH, AND OWN-BEFORE-PEOPLE. The altar-as-ox fear recorded; his own offering first; his atones for him and the people, theirs not for priests.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 9 + Onkelos Lev 9:15
claim_en: LIKE THE FIRST. The ka-rishon import of the application pattern; Onkelos decodes the verb as atoned-with-its-blood.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 10 + Onkelos Lev 9:16
claim_en: KA-MISHPAT THE PROCEDURE POINTER. One word imports the Lev-1 olah table (flay, cut, wholly, stand-and-throw, returned limbs); Onkelos: as-is-fitting.
THE FISTFUL SYNC. Milui-milui to Lev 2:2 (pebble/salt/frankincense-crumb disqualify); two meal offerings that day.
COMMUNAL SHELAMIM FROM HERE. The people's ox-and-ram seats the class; the seven services learned in an hour.
THE TRANSPOSED BLESSING. 9:22 recorded as a transposed verse; the palms-lifting earned forever; standing derived by the service pairing; the text sealed here, opened at Num 6:24-26.
THE JOINT ENTRY AND THE FIRE. The incense/blessing arms; Aaron's distress and the joint prayer; the fire answered by song; Onkelos's glory-revealed policy.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 1, 3-5, 9-10, 13-14, 16, 19-20, 29-31; Sifra, Tzav, Mekhilta DeMiluim I 12, 16, 36; Sifra Nedavah Chapter 2 5; Sifra Chovah Chapter 3 6; Mishnah Zevachim 10:1-2, 10:6, 14:4, 14:9-10, 5:3-4, 5:7; Horayot 3:6; Menachot 4:4; Parah 1:1; Tamid 4:2; Zevachim 61b:5, 89b:2-3, 101b:6; Yoma 3b:4; Shabbat 87b:6; Megillah 10b:8; Gittin 60a:13; Moed Katan 28b:13; Menachot 45a:12; Onkelos Lev 9:15, 9:16
claim_en: THE RUN GRADED AGAINST ITS SPEC — THE CALF FOR THE BULL, THE OUTER BLOOD WITH THE INNER CARCASS, THE ONE UNSTAMPED ACT, THE FIRE FORMULA AT TWO SEATS. Lev 9 compiled as a scene against the Lev 1-8 engines by live call (cold_run_shemini_day.py, 104 of 104 first run): the calf and goat against the spec's bulls with the deviation sourced; the outer blood protocol with the inner carcass rule, the burn phrase at 8:17 and 9:11 alone, 9:11 the one unstamped act; the calf whole before the ram against Zevachim 10:2's interleaving, filed as the hour's; the daily offering first; 'like the first' and 'as prescribed' as calls; the fat list as two inventories' union; the fire formula at 9:24 and 10:2 alone with its recorded tenure; the day as the eras table's first boundary; four effects; the scene on the engine.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 10-12, 17, 29-30; Sifra Nedavah Section 14 8; Menachot 9b:17, 10a:6, 19b:2-4, 93b:3, 59a:11, 62a:1, 62a:4-5; Beitzah 20a:5; Sotah 38a:6, 38b:7; Megillah 18a:3; Mishnah Menachot 1:2, 3:5, 5:3; Beitzah 2:4; Sotah 7:6; Onkelos Lev 9:16, 9:21
claim_en: THE RUN TEACHES THE SPEC — THE PALM, THE POINTER, THE PREPOSITION, THE BLESSING, AND THE FORK OVER WHETHER AN HOUR LEGISLATES. 9:17's 'his palm' makes every unmarked palm the right hand (Menachot 9b; Menachot 1:2 by call, now derived); 9:16's 'as prescribed' gives the obligatory burnt offering its hand-laying (Menachot 93b = Beitzah 20a); 9:10's 'from the liver' resolves Lev 3:4 (Nedavah 14 8); the eighth day's meal offering in the frankincense column (Menachot 59a); the blessing's posture, timing, place, and the high priest's hands read off 9:22; the fork — Rav's repetition against Shmuel's 'generations are not learned from the hour' (Menachot 19b); the wave's stack reconciled as two moments (Menachot 62a). Move M-22.
